name: @agentry/workbench-shared
description: The Agentry Workbench read-model contract (ADR-005 tier 2) — the server↔web transport types, owned once so both halves import one non-drifting definition. Type-only: no build artifact; consumed via direct src import / TS project refs. Leans on @agentry/flow for the closed on-disk unions (FlowTaskStatus, AgentState, FlowEvent, ReviewComment) rather than redeclaring them (ADR-005 tier 1).
